violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Particle board shelving units in storage room adjacent to kitchen showing wear and water pocking. No longer maintained sealed. Shelving edges need to be sealed as well. Particle board counter top above dish machine flaking wood bits from degrading.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder or bar soap. Hand soap dispenser in kitchen area not working at time. Needs repair/restock.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Floors, walls, and/or ceiling were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. Acoustic style ceiling tiles in kitchen.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Walls in storage room adjacent to kitchen have bare plaster patches. Needs sealing.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Particle board shelving in dry storage has unsealed edges and wear exposing bare wood surfaces.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Condensation issue with ductwork in dry storage room. Ceiling tile removed and bucket placed on shelving to collect leaking. Replace water stained/damaged ceiling tiles.
